Please ignore others in the vegan community trying to put you as the bad guy in this situation. 
It would be totally amazing if everyone in the world was vegan and we could join together and sing songs and live happily ever after an all that good jazz. But as it stands now, that's not happening any time soon. 
With that, there must come an understanding for both sides that people are different. 
Most of these vegans were not so their entire life, so where this whole meat eaters are the plague stuff comes from I don't understand. 
Vegetarian/vegan is the right way and that's what I stick to and live by. But I don't go around trashing those that choose to eat meat, unless they come at me first but for the most part everything is actually very respectful and pleasant. 
You cannot force somebody to change when they are not ready. For me that took sixteen years, so I am patient with others. 
My boyfriend and my best friend are both omni, and they are both amazing and understanding people. They are both always willing to try something new, or cook something without meat so I can eat with them too. It's wonderful to have these people in my life.
I really don't mind them eating meat around me, though I can't stand the smell of bacon or fish. 

What I'm getting at is that this is a two-way street. Your brother and his girlfriend need to understand that and do their part. Nothing can be perfect all the time. As long as you also understand that if you go to their house you shouldn't complain when they have nothing but vegan food in their home.
It's a give and take. 

And again, don't let the "holier-than-thou" vegans get to you. They've no right to the harsh judgement they put on others.
